info.title: Sous API
info.description: JSON API for weekly meal plans and the household profile. The week and year routes only read; the one write route saves a section of the household profile. The week document format version is the `schemaVersion` field. Every response carries `Cache-Control: no-store`. No cross-origin access is enabled, and Sous never answers a CORS preflight.

get.summary: Get the complete meal plan of one ISO week.
get.description: Uses the same query and document as the HTML page `/{year}/{week}`, read from one database snapshot. Any two-segment path under `/api` is a week path, so `/api/abc/1` is `invalid_week`, not a missing route.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: ISO week-year: exactly four decimal digits, 0001 to 9999 (years below 1000 are zero-padded, e.g. `0001`), and all seven days of the requested week must be representable. Anything else is `invalid_week`.

parameters.name: week
parameters.description: ISO week number, 1 to the number of weeks in that ISO year (52 or 53). Zero-padded but otherwise valid values (for example `044`) redirect permanently to the canonical path. Anything else is `invalid_week`.

308.description: A valid week with zero-padded path segments; permanent redirect to the canonical API path, e.g. `/api/2026/044` to `/api/2026/44`.

404.description: No plan for this valid week, or an invalid year or week.

error.message: No meal plan for this week yet.

405.description: Only GET is supported. No JSON body is guaranteed.

503.description: The database is unavailable. The body never contains database details.

get.description: The five profile sections with their texts and revisions, read from one database snapshot. Sections that were never saved have empty text.

405.description: Only GET is supported (`Allow: GET,HEAD`). No JSON body is guaranteed.

503.description: The database is unavailable. The body never contains database details.

put.summary: Replace the text of one profile section.
put.description: Optimistic concurrency: send the `revision` last read for the section as `expectedRevision`. If the section changed since, nothing is written and the response is 409 with the section as now saved. Saving the same text under the current revision succeeds and returns the same revision. The request must pass the same Host and Origin checks as `/mcp` (403 `forbidden` otherwise), must be `application/json` (case-insensitive, parameters allowed), and the body must be at most 64 KiB. CRLF line breaks in `text` are saved as LF. Checks run in this order: 403, 404, 415, 413, 400, 409, 503.

text.description: The new text, at most 4,000 characters as submitted. Not trimmed.

expectedRevision.description: The `revision` of the section as last read.

400.description: The body is not a JSON object with exactly the strings `text` and `expectedRevision`, or the text is longer than 4,000 characters.

error.message: The body must be a JSON object with text and expectedRevision strings, and no other fields.

403.description: The Host or Origin header is not allowed.

404.description: The key is not one of the five section keys.

405.description: Only PUT is supported (`Allow: PUT`). No JSON body is guaranteed.

409.description: The section changed since `expectedRevision` was read. Nothing was written.

error.message: The section changed since it was read.

413.description: The body is larger than 64 KiB, with or without a `Content-Length` header.

error.message: The request body must be at most 64 KiB.
The request body must be application/json.

503.description: The database is unavailable, or this instance has no write configuration. The body never contains database details.

get.summary: List the stored meal plans of one ISO week-year, or get the week that contains a date.
get.description: One single-segment route with two forms. A four-digit segment (`/api/2026`) is a year: it uses the same query and status rule as the HTML page `/{year}`, read from one database snapshot. A year without plans is 404 `year_not_found`, except the current year (the ISO week-year of today in the service timezone), which returns an empty `weeks` array. A date segment (`/api/2026-10-28`) returns the complete week document of the ISO week that contains the date, byte for byte what `/api/{year}/{week}` returns, with no redirect; a valid date whose week has no plan is 404 `week_not_found`, and a date-shaped segment that is not a real date (or whose week cannot be represented) is 404 `invalid_date`. Any other single segment returns `not_found`, as does any path under `/api` that matches no route.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Either an ISO week-year (exactly four decimal digits, 0001 to 9999) or a date `YYYY-MM-DD` (ASCII digits only, zero-padded, year 0001 to 9999, and the seven days of its ISO week must be representable, so the last valid date is 9999-12-26). Anything else is `not_found`; a date-shaped value that is not a valid date is `invalid_date`.

200.description: The year listing for a year segment, or the week document for a date segment.

year.summary: A year segment, e.g. /api/2026. A date segment returns the WeekDocument shown under getWeek.

404.description: A valid year without plans that is not the current year, a valid date whose week has no plan, a date-shaped segment that is not a valid date, or a segment that is neither.

week_not_found.summary: Valid date whose week has no plan

error.message: No meal plan for this week yet.

invalid_date.summary: Date-shaped segment that is not a valid date

not_found.summary: Neither a year nor a date, or a path under /api that matches no route

405.description: Only GET is supported (`Allow: GET,HEAD`). No JSON body is guaranteed.

503.description: The database is unavailable. The body never contains database details.

WeekDocument.description: The complete meal plan of one ISO week. Identical to the document embedded in the HTML page.

schemaVersion.description: API format version; independent of SQL migration versions.

days.description: Always seven entries, Monday (weekday 1) to Sunday (weekday 7), including days without a stored record.

shoppingLists.description: Every shopping list of the week in stored order, including lists not assigned to any day. Days refer to them by ID.

prepSessions.description: Prep sessions in stored order; empty when the week has none.

Week.description: Identity and dates of the ISO week.

subtitle.description: Optional one-line description of the week.

prepIntro.description: Optional introduction shown above the prep sessions.

id.description: Stable day ID; null when the day has no stored record (then meals and shoppingListIds are empty and reminder is null).

items.description: ID of an entry of the top-level shoppingLists.

shoppingListIds.description: Lists shown on this day, in stored order.

reminder.description: Day reminder; null unless the day has a reminder title.

Reminder.description: A short reminder attached to a day.

description.description: Free-text description; may mention several people.

kcal.description: Energy in kcal for the displayed individual's intake.

proteinG.description: Protein in grams for the displayed individual's intake.

fatG.description: Fat in grams for the displayed individual's intake.

carbsG.description: Carbohydrates in grams for the displayed individual's intake.

fiberG.description: Fibre in grams for the displayed individual's intake.

forTwo.description: Only controls the FOR TWO badge; nutrition is never multiplied for FOR TWO.

assemblyTime.description: Assembly time, display text, never parsed.

cookTime.description: Cooking time, display text, never parsed.

ShoppingList.description: A shopping list, possibly shown on several days.

ShoppingCategory.description: A category of a shopping list.

text.description: Display text including any quantity; never parsed or consolidated.

covers.description: Optional note on which days the session covers.

weekday.description: The day the session happens on, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday), or null when it has no day. A null weekday shows the session on no day. Not tied to `covers`.

PrepTask.description: One task of a prep session.

YearDocument.description: The stored weeks of one ISO week-year and its adjacent years. Identical to the data of the HTML page `/{year}`.

schemaVersion.description: API format version; independent of SQL migration versions.

previousYear.description: `year - 1` when it has at least one stored plan, otherwise null.

nextYear.description: `year + 1` when it has at least one stored plan, otherwise null.

weeks.description: Stored weeks of the year, newest first, including future weeks. Empty only for the current year without plans.

WeekSummary.description: One stored week in a year listing.

path.description: Canonical page path of the week, e.g. `/2026/44`.

Section.description: One section of the household profile.

title.description: The section's title: People, Food preferences, Kitchen, Planning habits or Other context.

text.description: Plain text with LF line breaks, at most 4,000 characters. Empty until saved.

revision.description: Opaque content hash of the section's key and text. Send it back as `expectedRevision`.

sections.description: Always five sections, in the order household, food, kitchen, planning, other.

RevisionConflict.description: The 409 body: the section changed since it was read.
